purpose: Teach: 本紙/減速/同市/出馬/課せ/部類/大綱/適性

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、本紙の創刊号にコメントされたぞ
lines.en: Your father — he wrote a comment for our newspaper's first issue when he founded it.
lines.style: Measured, reflective cadence. Quiet pride held in reserve. Not boastful — factual, the way a memory surfaces without forcing it. Gentle authority.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは事業の減速時期も冷静に判断された
lines.en: Yes. My father stayed calm and clear in his judgment, even when business slowed.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive tone. Not echoing — acknowledging, adding weight to what was said. Voice steady and grateful. Eye-contact steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、同市の競合と切磋琢磨されたぞ
lines.en: Your father competed with grace against rivals in the same city.
lines.style: Slow, nostalgic. Slight catch on 「切磋琢磨」 — the weight of real competition, real growth. Tender at the edges, not hard.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは業界団体の代表にも出馬された
lines.en: Yes. My father even ran to lead the industry association.
lines.style: Deliberate, respectful. Not defensive — offering evidence of breadth. Calm and clear. The voice of someone understanding the full scope of another's life.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員に過度の目標を課せなかったぞ
lines.en: Your father never burdened his staff with impossible targets.
lines.style: Soft certainty. This is something known, something valued. Slight warmth underneath — the memory of fairness. Not patronizing, just sure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは独自の部類の事業を作られた
lines.en: Yes. My father had the gift of seeing each person's real strengths.
lines.style: Warm, almost intimate now. The voice finding its center. Not claiming knowledge — offering what was lived. Quiet conviction, final and true.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、新方針の大綱を毎年示されたぞ
lines.en: Your father set out the direction clearly, year after year.
lines.style: Steady, confirming tone. This is continuity, consistency — the invisible foundation. Not grand, just reliable. A nod to constancy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の適性を見抜く目をお持ちでした
lines.en: Yes. My father possessed a remarkable eye for what each person was capable of becoming.
lines.style: Quiet closure. The final word carries the weight of a life understood. Tender, not wistful. At rest. The voice of someone speaking the deepest truth about someone loved.
